mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ABS(bt.amount)), 0) AS totalSpent, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN bt.create_time >= #{monthStart} THEN ABS(bt.amount) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS monthSpent, COUNT(DISTINCT bt.task_id) AS taskCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN v.status = 'SUCCESS' THEN bt.task_id END) AS successCount FROM balance_transaction bt LEFT JOIN video_task v ON v.id = bt.task_id WHERE bt.user_id = #{userId} AND bt.type = 'SETTLE'

SELECT COALESCE(v.model, '未知') AS model, COALESCE(SUM(ABS(bt.amount)), 0) AS amount, COUNT(DISTINCT bt.task_id) AS taskCount FROM balance_transaction bt LEFT JOIN video_task v ON v.id = bt.task_id WHERE bt.user_id = #{userId} AND bt.type = 'SETTLE' GROUP BY COALESCE(v.model, '未知') ORDER BY amount DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(bt.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COALESCE(SUM(ABS(bt.amount)), 0) AS amount FROM balance_transaction bt WHERE bt.user_id = #{userId} AND bt.type = 'SETTLE' AND bt.create_time >= #{startTime} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(bt.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date
